source.title: Glossary
source.description: Definitions disambiguating near-synonyms — subagents versus agent teams, connectors versus MCP servers, sandboxing versus permission rules — plus renamed terms like headless mode, each linking its owning doc.

source.title: Best practices for Claude Code
source.description: Verification loops Claude can close itself, plan mode before implementing, lean `CLAUDE.md` versus on-demand skills, `/clear` and subagents to reclaim context, parallel sessions, non-interactive headless (`claude -p`) fan-out, failure patterns.

source.title: Tools reference
source.description: Every built-in tool name for permission rules, subagent tool lists, and hook matchers; whether each prompts by default; the `ToolName(specifier)` formats; and per-tool behaviour such as Bash output limits.

source.title: Configure permissions
source.description: Allow, ask and deny rules deciding which tool calls need your approval, how patterns match Bash commands and file paths, modes like `acceptEdits` and `bypassPermissions`, and organisation-wide managed settings.

source.title: Extend Claude with skills
source.description: Authoring guide for `SKILL.md` files: where skills live, the frontmatter reference, controlling who invokes a skill, passing arguments, running one in a subagent, and sharing them beyond Claude Code.

source.title: Create plugins
source.description: Authoring walkthrough: `plugin.json` inside `.claude-plugin/` but `skills/`, `agents/`, `hooks/`, `.mcp.json` at the plugin root; testing with local `--plugin-dir` or hosted-zip `--plugin-url`; migrating `.claude/`; marketplace submission.

source.title: Plugins reference
source.description: What a plugin can ship — skills, agents, hooks, MCP and LSP servers, monitors, themes. `claude plugin` subcommands, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` versus update-surviving `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` and install scopes.

source.title: Run Claude Code programmatically
source.description: Headless `claude -p` for repeatable scripts — `--bare` for a fixed context, JSON and streaming output shaped by `--json-schema`, tool pre-approval, resuming sessions. CLI only.

source.title: Run agents in parallel
source.description: Chooser comparing subagents, agent view, agent teams and dynamic workflows by who coordinates and whether workers share files; plus worktrees, cross-session messaging, `/batch`, and `/tasks` status checks.

source.title: Create custom subagents
source.description: Reference for `.claude/agents/` files: where they live and which wins, every frontmatter field, the built-in Explore and Plan agents, `@` and `--agent` invocation, background runs, and `/subtask` forks.

source.title: Manage multiple agents with agent view
source.description: Terminal dashboard from `claude agents` for background sessions: dispatch with `--bg` or `/bg`, peek and attach to rows, `.claude/worktrees/` edit isolation, and the supervisor process that hosts them.

source.title: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions
source.description: Experimental, gated by `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS` — a lead spawning teammates sharing a task list and mailbox, contrasted with subagents; `teammateMode` split panes, plan approval, quality-gate hooks, limitations.

source.title: Message your other Claude Code sessions
source.description: Plain-text handoffs between independent sessions using `SendMessage` and `ListAgents`, discovered via `/list-agents`; `crossSessionInbound` accept, hold or refuse gating, `isolatePeerMachines`, the inbox socket, reply-only cross-machine delivery.

source.title: Orchestrate subagents at scale with dynamic workflows
source.description: When to choose one over subagents, skills and teams; `ultracode` triggering, bundled `/deep-research`, the `/workflows` view, saving scripts as commands taking `args`, resume rules, `workflowSizeGuideline`.

source.title: Run parallel sessions with worktrees
source.description: `--worktree` creating `.claude/worktrees/` checkouts, `EnterWorktree` mid-session, edits blocked against the main checkout, `isolation: worktree` subagents, `.worktreeinclude` for gitignored files, `worktree.baseRef`, cleanup, and non-git `WorktreeCreate` hooks.
